title: Model-Informed Evaluation of Drug-Drug Interaction Recommendations for Amlodipine and Nirmatrelvir-Ritonavir: A Hypothesis-Generating Analysis.
what: While nirmatrelvir-ritonavir effectively prevents severe COVID-19, its ritonavir component causes significant drug-drug interactions (DDIs). Current guidelines suggest mitigating this interaction by halving the amlodipine dose or moving to every-other-day (EOD) dosing, then resuming the standard regimen 3-5 days post-antiviral treatment.
original_title: Model-Informed Evaluation of Drug-Drug Interaction Recommendations for Amlodipine and Nirmatrelvir-Ritonavir: A Hypothesis-Generating Analysis.
headline: Drug-Drug Interaction Recommendations for Amlodipine and Nirmatrelvir-Ritonavir

title: Drug-Drug Interaction Assessment of WXFL10203614 With Rifampicin, Itraconazole and Metformin: A Three-Cohort Phase I Study.
what: To evaluate the effects of rifampicin and itraconazole on the pharmacokinetics (PK) of the Janus kinase 1 (JAK1) inhibitor WXFL10203614 and the effects of steady-state WXFL10203614 on metformin PK and safety. In this single-center, open-label, fixed-sequence, self-controlled Phase I study, 54 healthy participants were enrolled into three cohorts.
source: PubMed, Clinical pharmacology in drug development
original_title: Drug-Drug Interaction Assessment of WXFL10203614 With Rifampicin, Itraconazole and Metformin: A Three-Cohort Phase I Study.
headline: WXFL10203614 With Rifampicin, Itraconazole and Metformin

title: A Study of Rusfertide in Adults With Polycythemia Vera (PV)
what: Polycythemia vera (PV) is a long-term condition in which the bone marrow makes too many red blood cells (RBCs). Bone marrow is the soft tissue inside the large bones where blood cells are made.
